text:
ashley: Morning — can we lock a quick deployment review for Kairos private (VPC + on‑prem) this week? Need to confirm canary plan, networking preflight, and support runbook.

sam: I can do Tue/Wed afternoons PST. prefer Tue 3pm PST. Who else needs to be on the call?

leo: Tue 3 works for me. Add infra, support, and the customer eng lead (I'll DM the email). agenda: canary thresholds, outage rollback, and network ACLs.

priya: I can own canary plan. Can we include perf targets (p99 latency, token/s throughput) + a quick smoke test matrix?

ashley: yes — perf targets: p99 <= 350ms, sustained throughput target 100 req/s for initial canary. Smoke tests: auth, model load, KV cache hit.

ashley: linking the current runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kairos-private-deploy (section 2 = preflight). also snapshot of checklist below.

ashley: ```
# preflight checklist (short)
- verify VPC peering and routes
- confirm KMS key rotation policy
- check IP allowlist for customer
- confirm HA proxy config and certs
- run smoke-tests/quick-smoke.sh
```

sam: @priya can you add the canary steps to the runbook (small bullets) before Tuesday? I'll pull metrics dashboards into the call.

priya: yes — will add canary steps + the prometheus queries. expecting ~30m to update.

leo: quick question re: model variants — customer wants fallback to a 1.7B quantized variant if the main 7B node pool is saturated. Do we have an auto-failover policy doc?

ashley: we do — it's in infra playbooks. short version: routing policy will attempt tiered fallback: dedicated-7b -> dedicated-1.7b -> hosted-1.7b (read-only). We should confirm limits and account-level permissions on the call.

sam: ops-bot, can you post the current GPU pool capacity for the cluster we'll use?

ops-bot: Current capacity for cluster kairos-prod: 24/32 GPUs allocated, 8 GPUs free. Next auto-scale event: enabled at 20% free -> autoscaler cooldown 10m.

priya: good to know. that means canary should start at 2 nodes, ramp to 6 over 15m. I'll add that to the runbook.

ashley: ok finalizing: Tue 3pm PST / 6pm EST, 30 minutes. Agenda bullets in the event: 1) preflight signoffs (10m) 2) canary plan (10m) 3) rollback/fallback & post-deploy checks (10m).

sam: +1. I'll create the calendar invite and add the dashboards.

leo: I'll DM the customer eng lead and add their email to the invite.

priya: added canary steps to the runbook and included prometheus queries. small snippet: ```promql
rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="kairos"}[5m])
```

ashley: perfect. if no other blockers I'll post the invite and ping infra on Tue morning for final network check. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks all. :thumbsup:
